look.why: A deep open-ocean sky blue that evokes pelagic waters while keeping the slate-blue mottled flanks legible.

size.measure: total length 24–30 m (largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth)

habitat.text: Open oceans worldwide from polar feeding grounds to tropical breeding waters.

diet.text: Almost exclusively krill—filtering up to 4 tonnes of tiny crustaceans per day through baleen plates.

facts.text: The largest animal ever known to exist on Earth, with a heart roughly the size of a small car.
Its low-frequency songs reach up to 188 decibels and can travel hundreds of kilometres underwater.
